paragraphs: Rabbi Adda son of Rabbi Shimon, in Rabbi Natan’s name, Midrash Kohelet on “Guard your foot.” The same subject in Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, chapter 2, mishnah 3, is in Rabbi Yochanan’s name (but the reading is Rabbi Idi). Jerusalem Talmud, Megillah, chapter 1, halakhah 11: in Rabbi Yochanan’s name.
